reviews.t: Everyone should give this a try. You'll never know if it works for you.
reviews.x: When I first saw this product at a warehouse roadshow, I was sticker shocked! I thought to myself what kind of baloney are they trying to sell now??? The rep sampled the scrub and then this moisturizer on the back of my right hand. I compared my right hand from the left and my right hand was noticeably lighter in color with less lines AND baby's bottom smooth/soft. Amazing! If these products can do this on the first try, I can only imagine what it'll do to my face long term. I was sold on the pr

reviews.t: It's an amazing cream. My skin is very smooth and soft
reviews.x: I got this from my boyfriend for Christmas. It's an amazing cream. My skin is very smooth and soft. I have no wrinkles and I'm over 60 years old.

reviews.t: I got it at a home show and I like it. I let my daughter try it and ...
reviews.x: I got it at a home show and I like it. I let my daughter try it and she likes it too. We both have dry skin. So I found it at amazon and bought it. Great product but a lit pricy!

reviews.t: Love it but doesn't last that long
reviews.x: Great product but doesn't last as long as they say. I have a 6.7 oz jar of the aloe gold and I am almost out after 7 months. The product and reviews state the legs jar will last 1 and 1/2 years. Not quite accurate unless you are using it minimally.

reviews.t: The best moisturizing cream i have ever used
reviews.x: I honestly cant imagine life without this product.I am more comfortable in my skin. Burns.Bites Rashes. Sunburn, windburn. Very dry skin. I apply on wet skin for all day comfort... This is wonderful for the face. I use it on the tops of my hands and have very good luck with it diminishing dark spots.

See the picture on the website? Expect your product to look like the attached pictures instead. The old label that's at least three years old and that sets the right expectation for the product. Old and possibly expired. I've used this product for five years so I know this is expired product.

Just to avoid a lot of hassle I'm not taking a legal action against the company. I have decent skin and have no breakouts my entire life but using this for 2 days and my left side of face hurts soooo bad, it's full of rashes. Went and returned got it from Costco . The guy at returns was shocked the see my face and the reaction.. Was really disappointed it didn't work for me. Attaching pic this is after applying antibiotic ointments for 3 days. Still not sure whether these marks will ever go ;(

reviews.t: Best moisturizer I have ever had
reviews.x: Purchased at a trade show on the recommendation of a friend. I was very skeptical but agreed to try it.  I love it.  The fine lines at the corner of my eyes have disappeared.  Lines on my forehead have faded.  I have tried a number of major brand name products and this is the only one that has made a visible difference.  It is expensive but so are other products.

reviews.t: with daily use and I love how the skin on my face feels
reviews.x: I hesitated about buying this because of price, but the container lasted me over 2 years, with daily use and I love how the skin on my face feels!  Looking to buy it again!

This is a really good cream, but if you have dry skin, like I do, best to apply this RIGHT after you wash your face and it's still a little damp from toweling off, because  this tends to be very thick and works better if your skin is not totally dry.  I LOVE Infinite Aloe products, although they are pricey.......I think they're the best.
I love this product.  My skin feels tighter.

reviews.t: Bad product, it’s not working, expensive , very bad
reviews.x: Very bad It’s not a good one don’t buy

Am I the only one whose skin seems to be drying up with this cream?  I'm not trying to get out of a $400+ purchase.  I am willing to pay for something that works but my skin seems to feel tight from dryness.  I live in very dry Los Angeles and need a lot of help moisturizing my skin.  I'm on day 3 but I'm scared to do more.  The last moisturizer I used that also dried my skin badly was that purple jar from Kiehls with hyaluronic stuff.

reviews.t: Seems to be working. Sensitive skins beware
reviews.x: Seems good, with caveats. I've only been using it for a week. Got it at a trade show.  I've always had extremely dry,  sensitive,  allergic skin.  The pushy  sales person wanted to put it on my face.  I walked around the show with it on my hands and took the plunge to purchase it. Expensive yes but no more than Perricone. Pros: it seems to be working already on lines,  puffiness, and sagging. What some reviews describe as drying is the tightening effect. Cons: the fragrance.  Cheap, chemically a
I think this product is over rated.  There are a lot better products on the market for a lot less money.

I discovered this creme years ago (I already knew about Infinite Aloe as a moisturizer or skin healing creme), so I took a chance on this creme which is very expensive and will make most people pause.  However, since I started using it, my face is suspended in time.  I am 50 and people think I'm in my 30's.  I wear sun screen and take care of myself, but I credit this creme for looking much younger than my age.  In this case, you get what you pay for.

reviews.t: I love it. My mom and wife use it too
reviews.x: I am a guy and i love this cream because i can use the one cream for everything for my face. Feels great and makes my skin feel great. I have been using this for a couple months and it really helped with the puffiness i had around my eyes. I highly recommend it. Even though it seems expensive, it lasts a long time!!

Gives ur facial skin 24 hour moisture. My fine lines diminished. You don't even need make up coz ur skin will glow. Love it. I got mine at Costco roadshow and it was a steal...will definitely continue to use this amazing cream
So far, so good...just started using but read past reviews about this moisturizer.

reviews.t: May cause a skin reaction for some
reviews.x: This product caused a rather severe hypersensitivity /allergic reaction when i used it.  My skin dried out, flaked, burned and cracked.  I’m not sure what chemical caused this reaction but i have been using the original infinite aloe product for years and love it.  It took almost a week for the reaction to subside and my skin to get back to normal.  Ps. - the anti -aging cream made me look about 10 years older due to the irritation and tightness it caused.

I used this product for 2 days only and my face is red, puffy and feels like I just had a glycolic acid peel!! Seriously! My eyes and chin are itchy as well. Extremely bummed. I use the REGULAR less expensive Infinite Aloe and love it, so I thought the anti aging cream would even be better. Glad I only bought a small travel size and only paid 27 bucks.
Only one states that its .5 of. They do not look like the same amount. I paid same price for both.

I have used other infinity aloe products and loved them. I figured this would be great. For about $150 bucks it feels like I'm spreading was on my face. My face feels tight like it's covered in dried soap scum. There are particles of dried white product left on the skin. I gave it a week and do not notice any skin improvement. Can i get a refund? Money wasted.

i opened the container and was shocked that it was only half full  when i tried to get some cream out, the cream was almost frozen like, very waxy and would not spread at all  i sent it back do not buy this stuff from amazon  their regular infinite aloe cream is excellent  this stuff is awful

claims.text: Many reviewers find the cream highly effective, reporting smoother, softer, tighter skin and reduced fine lines and wrinkles.
Reviewers frequently describe the product as expensive or pricey, though several still consider it worth the cost.
Some reviewers report receiving old or possibly expired product with outdated labels, describing it as a bait-and-switch.
A few reviewers experienced negative skin reactions or dryness, including painful rashes and tight, dry-feeling skin.
Some reviewers note the product is thick and works best applied to damp skin, and that it may not last as long as claimed.
